data.headline: 阿嬤逆向全國方向感崩盤
data.ticker: 阿嬤一轉全場腿軟｜交流道秒變迴力鏢｜方向感列國家機密
data.anchor_script: 插播！阿嬤逆向上高速，竟說只是回頭拿蔥！前方車陣集體倒抽氣，連路邊風向袋都當場打結！工作人員抱著巨大軟墊衝出，交流道瞬間變成人體保齡球館！阿嬤安全停下，還問大家怎麼都走錯邊！現在全棚緊急清查左右手，晚餐的蔥究竟誰負責？純屬虛構，封閉棚景演出，真實道路千萬別模仿！
data.cast: Grandma is a 76-year-old woman with short curly silver hair, a purple floral blouse, beige trousers, and white sneakers; the road attendant is a 35-year-old man with short black hair, an orange safety vest over a plain navy shirt, navy trousers, and black shoes.

shots.scene_en: In a closed studio mock expressway, Grandma pedals a tiny red toy scooter opposite a procession of unoccupied inflatable cars, filmed from a high wide angle, with no text, letters, or logos visible.

Grandma stops her red toy scooter on the closed studio mock expressway and dramatically displays an empty grocery basket while the road attendant clutches his cheeks beside a knotted windsock, filmed in a low-angle medium shot with no text, letters, or logos visible.

The road attendant waddles toward the stationary Grandma carrying an enormous foam cushion and harmlessly bumps a row of foam cones into a padded heap on the studio roadway, filmed in a side wide shot with no text, letters, or logos visible.

Grandma stands safely beside her parked red toy scooter and points indignantly at the inflatable cars while the road attendant sits unharmed in the foam heap, filmed over his shoulder with no text, letters, or logos visible.

Grandma and the road attendant stand beside the parked toy scooter on the closed studio roadway, raising opposite hands in exaggerated confusion as a giant scallion prop descends between them, filmed in a frontal wide shot with no text, letters, or logos visible.
